contract_reset_preconditions: flat accounts, no pending order, no partial bucket; otherwise stop incomplete
fill_rule: first eligible minute open strictly after availability
flatten: scheduled final minute open; no forecast crossing session close
flatten_details: cancel pending orders at scheduled final minute open; missing minute stops incomplete without invented exit price
invalid_forecast: flat target; preserve available malformed paths and error
kronos_rule: sign(mean(three terminal forecast closes) - observed close)
momentum_rule: sign(current close - close four completed bars earlier)
prospective_collection: Commit separate collection preregistration before launching any continuing collector.
Archive dated calendar, contract selection, request identities, ordered raw observations and arrival times.
Preserve completion flags, timezone, revisions and gaps without deduplication or inferred completion.
Keep observations segregated from research exposure; freeze eligible sessions and execution assumptions before scoring.
Run a dependence-aware power gate before any future strategy test.
reversal: close then open, two charged sides
warmup: 128 completed same-contract 15-minute bars; reset on contract change
